evidence.reason: The cited ordering risk is addressed at the tip: commit 7f3f32a3529d673f4a5f9473fcb76f21345a91c7 processes reordered same-key rows above the resume point, and commit 75ddc92582832bdf8eb51c2c7e551c2cbe557695 had already moved recent-discovery continuation to row identity rather than updated_at order. That removes the alleged omission under same-second reordering, so the recommendation is no longer live.
